active_family: state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law with one stochastic source and one shared generative core; first backend remains AR flow matching unless diagnostics justify a switch
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, generic support-aware mixed discrete-continuous heads selected by one data-derived rule, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, factor-name-specific sparse heads, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: 736a falsified the first learned mixed-support no-update head as a repair for the real-VIX tri-scope framework. The mechanism remains one shared AR normalized-innovation flow with a generic train-no-change-selected Bernoulli no-update head, but the anchor-only falsifier failed before joint retraining: factor KS stayed 12/14 and AAA/BBB OAS regressed. normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, output_law, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: The current AR flow core remains coherent for liquid continuous factors, but sticky quoted OAS appears to be a different observation object: intermittent/stale quote updates with a point mass at zero plus conditional nonzero sizes. Recent intermittent-time-series literature supports explicit renewal/hurdle/Tweedie-style observation laws for this class; the simple Bernoulli add-on is not enough because event probability and nonzero scale are coupled.
last_result_summary: 737a literature-backed ideation after 736a: intermittent/sparse forecasting work treats zero-heavy series as a distinct probabilistic observation problem. Deep renewal processes model arrival timing and positive sizes; recent Tweedie likelihood work emphasizes a distribution with a point mass at zero and heavy tails. This supports the local evidence that sticky OAS should not be repaired by incremental threshold/gate knobs inside the same continuous innovation coordinate.

Recommended: create a liquid-factor framework scorecard that treats sticky quoted OAS as a documented observation-model limitation, while preserving OAS diagnostics as non-gated risk-manager monitoring. In parallel, define a separate future paradigm only if the objective requires publishable credit-spread law: a full hurdle/renewal observation model with conditional nonzero scale, applied generically to intermittent channels. Do not change AR flow backend for liquid IV/anchor/joint factors based on OAS alone.
